ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$, point $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$, and $BE=\frac{1}{3}BC$. If $BE=2\,\text{cm}$, what is the length of $AB$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $BE=\frac{1}{3}BC$ and $BE=2\,\text{cm}$, \\
then $BC=3BE=6\,\text{cm}$. \\
Given that point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$, \\
it follows that $AB=2BC=\boxed{12}\,\text{cm}$.
